name: Spacecore
subcategory: Extended play by The Devil Wears Prada
summary: Spacecore is characterized by the use of celestial bodies as pure decoration, embracing intense color palettes and dreamlike compositions that emphasize wonder and existential searching, sometimes with introspective questions (e.g., "Are we alone?").
description: Spacecore is characterized by the use of celestial bodies as pure decoration, embracing intense color palettes and dreamlike compositions that emphasize wonder and existential searching, sometimes with introspective questions (e.g., "Are we alone?").
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Escapism, wonder, fantasy, existential searching, individuality, dreaminess

visualDNA.colour: Violet, indigo, electric blue, magenta, black (space backgrounds), iridescent silver/glitter

fashion.Overview: Spacecore fashion incorporates the decorative cosmic imagery into wearable items, often favoring styles that utilize dramatic prints, glitter, and reflective materials, occasionally blending with Harajuku styles like Uchuu Kei. The look is characterized by a high reliance on cosmic prints and textures:
